channel.title: The Margin Wars | The Rulebook Wire [Preview]
channel.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review — official sources, practical moves.

item.title: Canada: RTR launch set for 9 November
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Payments Canada confirms a scheduled 9 November launch. This preview does not describe the service as already live. Who: Canadian banks, PSPs and payment users. Effective: 2026-11-09. Official source: https://www.payments.ca/canadas-real-time-rail-launch-confirmed-budget-2026

item.title: EU PSR: Council first-reading position
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents adoption of its first-reading position on 29 October. This is a legislative milestone, not an application date. PSD3 and PSR must be tracked separately; no implementation date is asserted here. Who: EU payment providers; not automatically UK firms. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15154-2026-INIT/en/pdf

item.title: PSD3: a separate Council milestone
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents its first-reading position on the payment and electronic-money services directive on 29 October. This is not an implementation deadline. Who: EU payment and e-money institutions; not automatically UK firms. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15152-2026-INIT/en/pdf

item.title: NZ moves on commercial cards
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The 22 October decision introduces commercial credit-card interchange limits on Mastercard and Visa. Who: New Zealand merchants and acquirers. Effective: 2027-04-22. Official source: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/projects/interchange-fee-regulation/

item.title: Pix DICT: refund monitoring default
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. DICT 2.13.0 changes the default value of Refund MonitorAccount to false. Review integrations for implicit defaults. Who: Pix participants and refund engineering teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bcb.gov.br/content/estabilidadefinanceira/pix/changelog.html

item.title: 3DS 2.4: draft, not a mandate
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. EMVCo reports that draft Protocol and Core Functions v2.4 is available for Associate and Subscriber review. No global migration deadline is asserted. Who: 3DS servers, SDK providers and authentication teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

item.title: Scheme fees come into view
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. First quarterly aggregate fee publications by designated card networks were due for the July–September period. Who: Card networks; acquiring teams. Effective: 2026-10-30. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Acquirer fee disclosures begin
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Qualifying large acquirers must publish merchant service fee data by merchant size and card type. Who: Large acquirers and merchants. Effective: 2026-10-30. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: UK scheme pricing: evidence required
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Relevant scheme-fee decisions must comply with the PSR’s pricing-governance direction from the end of November. Who: Visa, Mastercard and UK acquirers. Effective: 2026-11-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

item.title: Canada–EU: interlink work supported
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. A joint commitment supports work toward connecting instant payment systems. It is not an operating cross-border route. Who: Cross-border product and treasury teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.payments.ca/payments-canada-welcomes-joint-canada-eu-commitment-interlink-real-time-payment-systems

item.title: Australia: card surcharge reset
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. eftpos, Mastercard and Visa no-surcharge rules apply from 1 October after the RBA removed its prohibition on those rules. Who: Australian merchants and acquirers. Effective: 2026-10-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/faqs/index.html

item.title: Domestic interchange: lower caps
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Revised interchange regulation applies to domestic-issued card transactions acquired in Australia. Who: Australian acquirers and issuers. Effective: 2026-10-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Issuer compensation rules change
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The amended net-compensation regime starts, with transitional arrangements for 2026/27. Who: Card networks and issuers. Effective: 2026-10-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Next: prove interchange pass-through
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. First publication of large acquirers’ interchange pass-through measures covers October–December 2026. Who: Large acquirers and merchant finance teams. Effective: 2027-01-30. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Foreign-issued cards get a cap
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Interchange caps extend to foreign-issued card transactions acquired in Australia. Who: Cross-border acquiring teams. Effective: 2027-04-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Merchant statements get sharper
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. More statement detail is required from the first full statement period starting on or after 1 April. Who: Australian acquirers and merchants. Effective: 2027-04-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Scheme-fee roadmap expected
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The RBA expects a scheme-fee roadmap by 1 April; this is an expectation, not a new fee cap. Who: Card networks and acquiring teams. Effective: 2027-04-01. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

item.title: Same Day ACH: $10 million limit
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists an increase of the Same Day ACH dollar limit to $10 million for 17 September 2027. Who: US treasury, payout and originating-bank teams. Effective: 2027-09-17. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

item.title: ACH credits: 9am availability
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Non-Same Day ACH credits must be available by 9am in the receiving bank’s local time on settlement date. Who: Receiving banks and payout teams. Effective: 2026-09-18. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/rules/funds-availability-requirements-non-same-day-credit-entries

item.title: ACH: IAT definition changes
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists its revised definition of International ACH Transactions among the September changes. Who: ACH originators and compliance teams. Effective: 2026-09-18. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

item.title: ACH availability exceptions update
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists changes to funds-availability exceptions for Non-Same Day credit entries. Check the rule text before changing controls. Who: Receiving banks. Effective: 2026-09-18. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

item.title: IAT: optional date-of-birth field
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists the optional date-of-birth field for IAT entries for 19 March 2027. Who: IAT originators, banks and service providers. Effective: 2027-03-19. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

item.title: ACH: register IAT contacts
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Registration of IAT contacts in the ACH Contact Registry is listed for 1 January 2027. Who: ACH participants handling international entries. Effective: 2027-01-01. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

item.title: UK fee transparency: next stage
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Substantive information, transparency and complexity requirements apply from the end of July 2027, subject to the limited fee-logic extension. Who: Visa, Mastercard and UK acquirers. Effective: 2027-07-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

item.title: Small fee lines: a limited extension
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. ITC Standard B is deferred for qualifying fee lines generating £850,000 or less in annual UK gross revenue. During the extension, acquirers can request that information without charge. Who: UK acquirers and scheme billing teams. Effective: 2029-07-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/media/nqoettxg/ps26-1-sp-fees-market-review-extensions-decision-aug-2026.pdf

item.title: Safeguarding: the operating baseline
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Daily reconciliations, monthly reports and resolution packs form part of the strengthened safeguarding regime. Audit requirements have exceptions. Who: UK payment and e-money firms. Effective: 2026-05-07. Official source: https://www.fca.org.uk/firms/emi-payment-institutions-safeguarding-requirements

item.title: CHAPS: November release deferred
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Bank of England deferred its entire November 2026 RTGS standards release. This notice does not establish a replacement deadline. Who: CHAPS and RTGS participants. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news/2026/august/delay-to-the-november-2026-rtgs-standards-release

item.title: Pix DICT: recovery API clarifications
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The September release candidate adds FundsRecoveryId path-parameter documentation and clarifies refund-request restrictions. A release candidate is not a compliance deadline. Who: Pix participants and fraud operations. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bcb.gov.br/content/estabilidadefinanceira/pix/changelog.html

item.title: 3DS approvals: conditional extension
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. EMVCo’s Q3 update reports conditional approval extensions for eligible products intending to migrate to v2.4.0.0. Confirm product-specific eligibility. Who: 3DS product providers. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

item.title: Agentic payments: intent framework draft
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. EMVCo’s draft framework introduces Intent Services for consumer-authorised intent. It is a specification-development step, not a deployed network mandate. Who: Agentic checkout and payment product teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

item.title: Reg II: proposal watch, not a new rate
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Federal Reserve proposal docket is the source to monitor. No final rate, litigation outcome or effective date is asserted in this preview. Who: US debit economics and regulatory teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/apps/proposals/FR-0000-0095-01/details
